faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Flat Washer (ISO 7089) suitable for Precision flat washer for bolted assemblies?
faq.a: Titanium Flat Washer (ISO 7089) uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address fastener operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Flat Washer (ISO 7089)?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Flat Washer (ISO 7089) is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for precision flat washer requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Flat Washer (ISO 7089) require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. precision flat washer components require Passivation per ASTM B600 followed by hot DI water rinse 70C minimum to prevent flash rust on finished surfaces — tailored for precision flat washer application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Flat Washer (ISO 7089) shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Flat Washer (ISO 7089) includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet precision flat washer specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
